title: Daily time use of men and women
body: A time use survey conducted by the Government of India in six states (1998-99) recorded how an average man and an average woman spend a day (hours:minutes). Income generating work: men 6:00, women 2:40. Household and related work: men 0:30, women 5:00. Talking, gossip: men 1:25, women 1:20. No work/leisure: men 3:40, women 3:50. Sleep, self-care, reading etc.: men 12:25, women 11:10. The work done by men is more visible because most of it leads to the generation of income. Women also do some direct income generating work, but the bulk of their work is household related, which remains unpaid.
